mapper.select: SELECT conv.conversation_id, latest.plugin_id, p.name AS plugin_name, latest.status, first.create_time, latest.create_time AS update_time FROM ( SELECT conversation_id, MAX(round) AS max_round FROM ai_chat_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY conversation_id ) conv INNER JOIN ai_chat_message first ON first.conversation_id = conv.conversation_id AND first.round = 1 AND first.role = 'user' INNER JOIN ai_chat_message latest ON latest.conversation_id = conv.conversation_id AND latest.round = conv.max_round AND latest.id = ( SELECT m.id FROM ai_chat_message m WHERE m.conversation_id = conv.conversation_id AND m.round = conv.max_round ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN plugin_info p ON latest.plugin_id = p.id ORDER BY latest.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{count}
